description:
Step 1 of attaching a user image to a design: get a presigned upload URL.

Returns a presigned `url`, `method` (PUT), and `headers`. The caller PUTs
the raw image bytes straight to `url` (they never pass through Compass),
then calls `design_confirm_image_upload` with `upload_url`=that `url`.
Prefer `design_get_image_upload_page` when the user has the file but you
don't — it hands them a drag-and-drop page.
name: design_request_image_upload

anyOf.description:
Canonical short-circuit response shape.

`status` is always `"error"` — acts as a discriminator for LLM consumers.
`error` is a machine-readable code (e.g. `session_not_found`).
`reason` is a human-readable explanation of why the call failed.
`detail` carries structured extra context (ids, available values, etc.).

title: Request an image upload slot
